name: compiler
title: A loop that waits for a flag
summary: One worker waits in a loop for a flag that another worker sets after some busy work. The flag is plain, volatile or atomic, and the loop the compiler emitted decides whether the waiter ever sees it.

controls.name: delay
controls.label: Setter's busy steps before setting the flag

controls.name: flag
controls.label: The flag
controls.hint: plain: int. volatile: volatile int. atomic: _Atomic int, read with memory_order_relaxed.

results.name: outcome
results.label: Outcome
results.what: whether the waiter's loop ended, and on what value

results.name: seen
results.label: Value the loop ended on
results.what: what the waiter read when its loop stopped; 0 means it stopped without seeing the flag

results.name: elapsed
results.label: Elapsed
results.what: from the start barrier opening to the last worker finishing, or the timeout

trace.what: a model of the loop the compiler emitted: a load every time round, or one load before the loop

results: value the waiter's loop ended on
